entries.subject: Selected source model
entries.finding: Checked 2026-09-09. Selected DAMIT model [2012](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/2012), version **2018-07-18**. Convex lightcurve shape, uniformly scaled to the AKARI effective diameter of 27.12 ±1.31 km. Model fields and mesh measurements.
